text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy v2026.03.21-rc6 to eu-west-1 finished. Post-deploy smoke: warmup-heartbeat and kv-prefill. Observed 4/120 failing probes (3.3%) — small 503/429 tail on warmup-heartbeat.

rachel: seeing p95 spike to 900ms and a few 503s in the synth dashboard. Hosts: eu-w1-gpu-14, eu-w1-prefill-06 show errors.

synth-watchdog: failing probes detail: 4 probes, errors: "kv warmup timeout", "prefill-throttle". pattern concentrated on same two nodes.

mehul: do we pin those hosts or reduce canary? change window is open for 40m.

oncall: recommend quick pin of affected hosts back to stable model and route prefills to stable path while we triage. Low blast radius.

rachel: agreed. please run: `deploy-bot pin-hosts --hosts eu-w1-gpu-14,eu-w1-prefill-06 --model rwd-stable --reason "postdeploy warmup/prefill failures"` and add note to release notes.

deploy-bot: Pin command accepted. Hosts will switch to rwd-stable. Estimated completion 35s.

synth-watchdog: scheduled recheck in 90s.

(90s later)
synth-watchdog: recheck: failing probes reduced to 0/120. p95 returned to baseline.

rachel: filing RW-1499 with logs and repro steps. release-note: "Paused canary on two hosts due to warmup/prefill transient failures; hosts pinned to stable; investigation ongoing."

oncall: monitoring for 60m. alert if probe failure >1%.
